thread:
maria: FYI were seeing a class of provisional-overcount spikes tied to short-lived route handoffs + toolcall latency. Canary orgs flagged this morning.
ryan: example trace?
maria: pasted a trimmed router trace:
```
SESSION=xyz789 region=eu-west start=1610001000
client connects -> stream opens
seq=40 toolcall starts (external fetch) provisional_tokens=90 written by worker-7
client disconnects (TCP reset) at seq=41
router assigns session to worker-12, worker-12 resumes and writes provisional_tokens=90 for the continuing seq range
confirm path eventually records a single confirmed 90, but provisional totals retained both writes => console provisional=180
```
aj: so the ledger confirm dedupes but provisional index keeps both.
sophia: how are provisional records keyed today? session+seq_range only?
ryan: yes; theres no writer UUID in the provisional row. If two workers race they both insert overlapping provisional ranges.
denis: ownership race. Worker A writes provisional then dies. Worker B resumes and reasonably writes provisional because it lacks visibility into As failed heartbeat.
maj: is this correlated with toolcalls specifically?
maria: most spikes involve toolcalls because toolcalls extend the server-side response window and increase chance of disconnect mid-call.
sophia: short-term mitigation: hide provisional totals when we detect overlapping provisional ranges for a session and show "estimating". But thats just UX; root cause remains.
ryan: longer-term: add a provisional_uuid emitted at write time and an async metric event. Then we can dedupe provisional rows by uuid at reconcile. We can also sprinkle worker_id and lease_id to telemetry to identify handoffs.
maj: sounds reasonable. What about a read-lease approach where a worker acquires seq-range lease; if another worker tries to write overlapping provisional it must check active lease and fail-over semantics?
denis: that requires a consistent lease store (redis/etcd) and careful latency budget. Could be toggled behind feature flag.
sophia: I want an actionable telemetry plan before we add cross-shard indexes: 1) emit provisional_uuid, writer_worker, lease_ttl as an event 2) surface a new Grafana panel "provisional_dupe_rate" per-org 3) alert if >10% for an org for 30m
aj: sampling: enable full telemetry for 0.5% orgs initially.
ryan: implementation steps I propose: A) quick PR: include provisional_uuid in metering write and emit metric event (cheap), B) console change: show tooltip and mark sessions with overlap flag, C) rollout sampling and collect 2 weeks of data.
maj: UX: console should avoid alarming language. Tooltip copy: "Provisional tokens are an operational estimate and may include transient duplicates during route handoffs. Final billed tokens reflect confirmed ledger entries." Add link to docs.
sophia: ledger change needs to keep audit trail. If we dedupe provisionals later we should mark them as "deduped" with pointer to canonical provisional_uuid rather than delete.
ryan: agree. Reconcile algorithm: at confirm time check for earlier provisional_uuid(s) that overlap seq_range -> accept earliest as canonical, mark others deduped. Simple and preserves rows.
denis: sketching a lease-based guard too: when writing provisional set lease in redis with seq range key, TTL equals expected toolcall window + grace. Resuming worker will attempt to adopt lease via compare-and-swap. If lease expired or missing, it can write provisional; if lease exists pointing to dead worker, we merge instead of writing duplicate.
maj: concerns: redis outage could block provisional writes -> need fallback to optimistic writes. Feature flag again.
maria: product notes: clarify console estimates vs billed, add a short banner when canary sampling enabled so customers know they may see provisional noise.
aj: action items: @ryan add provisional_uuid + event (PR today), @maj add provisional_dupe_rate metric + tooltip mock (task), @denis spike lease store prototype (experiment), @aj prepare canary org list and sampling toggles.
maria: ping @metering-bot to create alert when provisional_dupe_rate > 10% per-org 30m.
metering-bot: created alert "provisional_dupe_rate_high" threshold 10% per-org 30m. Link: https://alerts.internal/prov-dupe/552460
ryan: will open the PR and enable sampling flag for 5 canary orgs.
maj: I'll also update console help docs and add the banner copy.
sophia: timeline: telemetry + UI in 2 weeks, collect data 2-3 weeks, then design ledger reconcile and optional lease guard for following sprint.
maria: OK. Let's reconvene in eng-platform weekly to review telemetry. Thanks all :thumbsup:
